component.name: Telamon Gates
component.summary: Chat with an AI model that runs on your own computer

description.p: Telamon Gates is the AI chat of Telamon OS. Ask a question and the reply streams in as it is written, with formatted text, tables and code you can copy in one click.

Conversations are kept as plain files on your computer, grouped by day in the sidebar and easy to search. Pick a model, set a system prompt, and watch how much of your graphics card's memory is in use.
Web search: Chat, Code and Agent mode can search the web and read pages, with Brave Search, Tavily or your own SearXNG. The API key is kept in the system keyring.
Deep Research mode plans the question, searches, reads the sources and writes a report with citations.

More robust: a model that runs out of memory is retried with a smaller context, downloads check for free space, damaged conversations are set aside instead of lost, and a second launch brings the open window forward.
Recommended models on the Models page: one click gets a tested model for coding, for chat and stories, or for small graphics cards.
Code and Agent mode can use their own model (Settings, Model for Code).
Chat and Story replies come faster: they ask the model for brief reasoning.
Starts faster: the agent's sandbox is checked when Agent mode is first used, not at every launch.
Local models, an agent and a fleet:

ul.li: Runs models with llama.cpp on the graphics card, and finds and downloads them from Hugging Face
Modes for chat, stories and code, with SystemOne picking one for each message, and your own modes
Agent mode: works in a sandboxed folder with tools, and asks before it changes anything
Fleet: several agents on one goal, on a dashboard
Pictures and files in messages; edit, branch and export conversations
Faster: rewriting text up to 10 times quicker, speed-up drafts for bigger models, the model ready while you type

description.p: First release: conversations with streaming replies, a sidebar grouped by day, tokens per second and a VRAM meter.
